payload.note: Inertial/collision evidence maps the Noetix review profile onto Moonphys composite primitive-shape mass properties, collision bounds, terrain collisions, patch-load contact wrench torque, support-wrench motion preview with impulse and kinetic-energy accounting, narrow-phase self-collision manifolds, adjacent URDF-link self-collision exclusions, generic manifold resolution, Moonphys world body-pair contact response, and impulse accounting. It remains review evidence only because mass, inertia, and collision geometry are not authoritative Moonrobo URDF tags yet.
